offending_extra_words: and Customer may obtain the same or similar services from any third party
reasons: Preferred position is achieved: the sole-and-exclusive supplier commitment is deleted and Vendor is expressly non-exclusive, so no exclusivity obligation binds Customer.

Minimality fails: the added affirmative right to source from any third party duplicates the protection already delivered by "non-exclusive" (and by the margin comment's cited Sections 2.1/12.3), expanding 15 words to 25 (ratio 1.67) and exceeding the changed-character limit (0.622).
A tighter edit such as replacing "sole and exclusive" with "non-exclusive" (or striking 2.2 entirely) would suffice; the surplus sentence is unnecessary boilerplate rather than a needed mechanic.
Intent is preserved: no other commercial term is disturbed, and no undefined term, contradiction, or dangling mechanic is introduced.
